sourceText: Implement a future-domain Proof-or-Stop PINN claim-admissibility extension with explicit evidence-bound lifecycle control and reproducible benchmark checks.
normalizedOutcome: Users can run a bounded proof-or-stop extension path for PINN claims that mechanically blocks stale/mismatched evidence from advancing lifecycle transitions.
acceptanceClaim: ProofStory artifacts include claim/evidence schema, registry updates, lifecycle gate predicates, benchmark harness controls, and reporting integrations with explicit boundaries and no PDE claims.
